description: The line plot illustrates the similarity of different configurations of a multilingual language model (LLM) across various layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Similarity," is also linear, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. There are four lines representing different configurations: "en&en" in red, "en&es" in blue, "en&el" in green, and "en&bn" in purple. The "en&en" line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.35 between layers 4 and 6, and then declines to about 0.10 by layer 22. The "en&es" line begins at a similarity of around 0.05, peaks at approximately 0.20 between layers 4 and 6, and ends at about 0.10 by layer 22. The "en&el" line starts at a similarity of about 0.05, peaks at around 0.15 between layers 4 and 6, and ends at about 0.05 by layer 22. The "en&bn" line begins at a similarity of around 0.05, peaks at approximately 0.10 between layers 4 and 6, and ends at about 0.05 by layer 22. All lines show a general decline in similarity as the layer number increases, with a significant increase in similarity at layer 22.
